WindowSource.EditDefinitionHint.zh: 要更改源内容，请进入共享定义编辑。
WindowSource.EditDefinitionHint.en: Edit the shared definition to change its source.

WindowSource.Status.Disconnected.zh: 已保存画面 · 未连接

WindowSource.Status.PausedByUser.zh: 已暂停 · 显示最后画面

WindowSource.Status.SuspendedHidden.zh: 无可见引用 · 已暂停

WindowSource.Status.SuspendedMinimized.zh: 源窗口已最小化 · 已暂停

WindowSource.Status.NoRecentFrame.zh: 暂无新画面 · 保留最后画面
WindowSource.Status.NoRecentFrame.en: No new frame · Last image retained

WindowSource.Status.SourceClosed.zh: 源窗口已关闭 · 请重新绑定

WindowSource.Status.SourceHidden.zh: 源窗口不可见 · 已暂停

WindowSource.Status.SourceLimit.zh: 最多同时显示 4 个实时源 · 当前显示保存画面
WindowSource.Status.SourceLimit.en: Four live sources at a time · Showing the saved image

WindowSource.PickerHint.zh: 选择一个窗口后预览并裁剪源内容。此处只列出窗口信息。
WindowSource.PickerHint.en: Choose one window to preview and crop. This list contains window information only.

WindowSource.NoWindows.zh: 没有可用窗口。可打开目标窗口后刷新。
WindowSource.NoWindows.en: No windows available. Open the target window, then refresh.

WindowSource.QueryFailed.zh: 无法读取窗口列表，请重试。
WindowSource.QueryFailed.en: Could not load windows. Try again.

WindowSource.CropHint.zh: 在完整源画面中拖出保留区域。目标图层框保持不变；工程保留完整源画面，便于以后重新裁剪。
WindowSource.CropHint.en: Drag the region to retain. The destination frame stays unchanged; the project keeps the full source image for later recropping.

WindowSource.InvalidPreview.en: The source preview could not be displayed.
